name: TeamStarWolf - Living-off-the-Land (LOTL)
description: Curated practitioner view of Living-off-the-Land (LOTL) behaviors, not an official MITRE mapping. Abuse of built-in, signed, or legitimate system binaries, scripts, interpreters, and admin tooling to execute, persist, move, and exfiltrate while blending into normal activity. Cross-tactic selection of Enterprise ATT&CK techniques; scores indicate curated membership tier (core vs supporting), not incident frequency. Every technique ID and tactic is validated against the workbench's bundled ATT&CK v19.2 data.
